code.title: Code and approvals
code.empty: No code candidate has been recorded.
code.discoveryUnavailable: Code candidate discovery is unavailable on this server.
code.unavailable: Code evidence is unavailable on this server.
code.sourceUnavailable: You cannot currently read the source evidence. No source details or approvals are shown.
code.truncated: Only the latest 50 code candidates are listed.
code.noBuild: No build is bound to this candidate.
code.reportHint: Runtime-reported results and current applicability are separate from human QA approval. Source-only reports do not prove a build.
code.noReports: No test report is recorded for this candidate.
code.executionHint: Deployment and rollback results come from the integration. Approval alone does not execute either action.
code.noExecution: No deployment or rollback result is recorded.
code.createHint: Choose a confirmed sub-issue and its observed pull request head. Saving a candidate grants no approval and starts no work.
code.artifactHint: Use an existing artifact approval from the source issue. The server verifies its identity and your access.
code.approvalHint: Review the exact candidate and selected evidence. Release and rollback approvals authorize an action; they do not record its execution.
code.notSignable: This decision is not currently available. Refresh the evidence and review the blockers.
code.reviewed: I reviewed this exact candidate and evidence
code.revokeHint: Revocation is a new record. The original decision and its reason stay in the history.
code.advanceHint: This changes the business stage only. It does not start an agent or deploy a build.
code.moreBlockers: More blockers exist. Refresh the current stage evidence.

pullRequestStates.unlinked: Pull request is no longer linked

testInput.title: Test input
testInput.subject: Candidate {{candidate}} · version {{version}}
testInput.hint: Choose an Agent or squad with the mention controls, then review and send the comment. Queuing input does not mean tests ran or passed.
testInput.unavailable: This original candidate is not currently eligible for test input. Review its current stage, approval and source access, or remove the test subject.

report.logUnavailable: The original log is no longer retained. Complete report details are unavailable.
report.unavailable: Test report details are currently unavailable.

execution.operationHint: A committed request consumes its approval. Pending, uncertain or not-started requests are not deployment results. Revoking an approval cannot cancel a committed execution request.
execution.unavailable: Execution requests and rollback evidence are unavailable on this server.
execution.boundedHistory: Each evidence group shows up to 50 records.

completion.title: Completion authorization
completion.hint: If the project requires delivery acceptance, review a sub-issue artifact and authorize this exact completion. The server checks stage evidence separately.
completion.referenceHint: An existing reference grants no new permission. The server verifies this exact result, status and current authority when you complete.
completion.empty: No readable artifact is available for this source.
completion.unavailable: Completion evidence or authorization is unavailable. Refresh current evidence or query the original request.
completion.authorized: Authorization recorded. Completion still requires confirmation.
completion.unknown: The original result is not confirmed. Query it before creating another request.
completion.ready: The selected authorization is ready for this completion.
completion.changed: The result or target changed after authorization. Restore the original intent or revoke and review again.
